title: RecoverFlow AI
summary: A merchant console for failed-payment recovery, built for the Razorpay AI Buildathon.
built: Next.js and TypeScript console with integer-paise money handling and a SHA-256 audit chain. Cases routed to approval need two different reviewers.
checked: CI on main passed 601 unit and application tests and 82 browser tests on 28 October 2026. In the live demo's 100-invoice synthetic batch, predicted recovery was 63.4% against 50% observed.
limits: Live payment recovery and provider onboarding are not enabled. AI cannot run payments or change audit history.
value: Helps merchant operations teams decide which failed recurring payments are worth recovering, and who approved each action.
outcomes: 601 unit and application tests and 82 browser tests passed in CI on 28 October 2026.
On a 100-invoice synthetic batch, predicted recovery was 63.4% against 50% observed.
Cases routed to approval need two different reviewers.
role: Built the console, recovery logic, data model and test suites.
limitNote: Live payment recovery is not enabled, and results come from synthetic data.

title: ShaRecon AI
summary: Three-way reconciliation of Razorpay payments, settlement batches and bank credits.
built: A control center with four-factor match scoring, exception triage, and a tamper-evident audit export.
checked: 97.1% link precision and recall on 80 hand-written stress cases. CI on main passed 141 automated and 50 end-to-end tests.
limits: It moves no live money, and results come from controlled datasets. The first run on those 80 cases had 7 unsafe auto-resolutions out of 42, a ₹28,100 exposure. Rules added in October removed them, so these cases can no longer count as held out.
value: Helps finance teams match Razorpay payments, settlement batches and bank credits, and hands every doubtful case to a person.
outcomes: 97.1% link precision and recall on 80 hand-written stress cases.
141 automated and 50 end-to-end tests passed in CI on 23 October 2026.
The AI only writes advisory notes. A deterministic engine assigns every match.
role: Built the reconciliation engine, control center, evaluation lab and audit export.
stack: TypeScript, Playwright, Gemini for advisory notes
limitNote: It moves no live money, and results come from controlled datasets.

title: ResumeScore
summary: Resume and job-match review that runs in the browser by default, so the text stays on your device.
built: PDF, DOCX and text extraction with review, scoring and local editing. Consent-gated AI critique code stays switched off in builds.
checked: Typecheck, lint, unit, browser and accessibility suites are defined in the repository.
limits: It does not predict hiring outcomes or certify ATS compatibility. Paid AI stays disabled, and the repository marks production as not yet approved.
value: Helps candidates review a resume against a job description without uploading it anywhere by default.
outcomes: Analysis runs in the browser by default, so the text stays on the device.
Deterministic features run without any provider keys.
Paid AI is locked off at build time.
role: Built extraction review, scoring, job matching, the local editor and export, plus the tests.
stack: TypeScript, in-browser PDF and DOCX extraction
limitNote: It does not predict hiring outcomes, and production is not yet approved.

title: CreditGuard AI
summary: Credit default risk model with calibrated probabilities and local explanations.
built: Calibrated Random Forest, cost-sensitive threshold and local SHAP explanations.
limits: Calibrated Random Forest, 7,292 holdout records, 1.7% defaults. A 5:1 cost threshold raises recall from 24.39%, and 64% of defaults are still missed.

title: Amazon ML Challenge 2026
summary: Merchant entity resolution across noisy records.
built: Candidate index and a hard-negative LightGBM classifier.
limits: 19-feature LightGBM on a local 5,000-anchor holdout, not a leaderboard score. Code is private.

title: LFMT slag detection
summary: Simulated infrared thermography for finding subsurface slag in mild steel.
built: Python and MATLAB thermal solvers with signal-processing pipelines and a research portal.
limits: Simulated thermal testing across 4,030 evaluations, not physical steel plates. A separate MATLAB benchmark reports different detection rates.

title: NeuroLearn AI
summary: a fixture-based multilingual learning demo in English, Telugu and Hindi
built: Diagnostics, deterministic grading and a research coordinator.
checked: Automated checks are defined in the repository.
limits: The public demo uses fixtures. Provider inference is not verified live.

title: FarmLink AI
summary: a full-stack marketplace prototype for farmers
built: Next.js marketplace prototype with Prisma and Supabase.
